newsitem.title: BULGARIA: TENNIS-BULGARIA'S MALEEVA OPTS OUT OF FED CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BULGARIA'S MALEEVA OPTS OUT OF FED CUP.

text.p: Bulgaria's top tennis player Magdalena Maleeva has opted out of the Fed Cup qualifiers in Bari on April 21, state news agency BTA said on Tuesday.

"Bulgaria's team has no realistic chances to win the qualifiers because it cannot win against teams like Italy, Hungary, etc, as the country has no strong players," BTA quoted Maleeva's letter to the Bulgarian Tennis Federation as saying.
The Federation said Bulgaria's team for the qualifiers would comprise Dessislava Topalova, Galina Dimitrova, Teodora Nedeva and Radoslava Topalova.
